content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Aiken

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high-school diploma plus five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full education and experience criteria to verify you meet the baseline. Document your project hours and leadership roles—you'll need this for your application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, learning core project-management domains directly from active certified practitioners. Our structured curriculum covers all exam domains and prepares you to apply for PMI certification.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and formally apply for the PMP credential through the Project Management Institute. Report your education, experience, and training completion. Pay PMI's examination fee to activate your exam eligibility and lock in your testing window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam at a Pearson VUE testing center or via remote delivery. Demonstrate mastery of project-management knowledge and sit for the four-hour, 180-question assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) every three years to renew your PMP. Pursue training, volunteer project-management work, or teach others. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning pathways to help you stay current and advance your career in Aiken's project-driven industries.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
